title: Mahjong Chill Sort
description: Stack, sort, and clear crisp Mahjong tiles in a relaxing brain-tickling sorting parlor—clean visual clarity and endlessly replayable layouts.
controls: Tap free Mahjong tiles to group matching pieces and clear the table cleanly.
